hero.srTitle: CPigs — Satire, Games & Technology Against Corruption
hero.description: An artistic and educational project that uses satire, games, and collectible cards to make corruption easier to understand, question, and discuss. We take serious subjects and approach them differently.

games.title: We Don't Tell You What To Think.
games.titleHighlight: We Give You Reasons To Question.
games.description: CPigs creates a relaxed space where it's possible to recognize corrupt behavior without pointing fingers. Through play, each person understands how small decisions — shortcuts, favors, silence — transform into entire systems.
games.description2: We don't give answers. We give situations, choices, and consequences. The rest is a conversation that stays with you after the game ends.

game1.title: Not the Pigs' Fault
game1.description: A strategic deduction game: discover who pulls the strings, measure the cost of each choice, and face the consequences of your decisions.

game2.title: Force Game
game2.description: Card confrontation based on Burn Power. The stronger your hand, the greater the impact — inside and outside the game.

moreThanGame.title: More Than a Game
moreThanGame.description: Behind the cards is a reflection on power, greed, and how easily we normalize what should shock us.
moreThanGame.quote: What if it's not the pigs' fault? What if each of us has a corrupt little pig inside?

tokenomics.title: Social Token
tokenomics.description: What if helping could be more relaxed and fun? Coinks are the energy of the CPigs community. When you burn a card, it leaves circulation and the corresponding Coinks go directly to a partner association chosen by the community. Less bureaucracy, more impact — and a good dose of humor along the way.
tokenomics.distributionNote: Each Coink has a defined destination. The largest share goes back to those who act: community and associations.

burn.title: BURN SIMULATOR
burn.disclaimer: Demo simulation. No cards are burned here.

community.title: COMMUNITY
community.subtitle: ENGAGEMENT & IMPACT
community.quote: Not by the Hair of My Chinny-chin-chin

guerrilla.title: Guerrilla Marketing — Burn the Paper
guerrilla.desc: Filmed street actions: paper burning, questions lingering. From flash mob campaigns to gaming fairs, real-world interventions are part of the brand from day one.

spaces.title: X Spaces — Good Deed Week
spaces.desc: Every Sunday, an open conversation about the week of good deeds. Dissecting corruption, exposing real-world issues, and challenging systemic problems.

journalism.title: Solutions Journalism
journalism.desc: Interviews with those seeking answers rather than blame. Reporting responses to social issues anchored in credible evidence.

goodDeeds.title: Good Deeds Wall
goodDeeds.description: Write your good deed of the day. Read others. Let yourself be contagioned.

backers.title: ENTER THE CPIGS WORLD
backers.subtitle: To play “Not the Pigs' Fault” you need 1 Card. For the “Force Game” you'll need 3 Cards.
backers.description: Cards give access to games and fuel the burn that funds associations.

perks: Join the co-founders in building the brand
